real_qa.q: What are the seven most common reasons roofing companies' Facebook ads fail?
real_qa.r: The seven problems are: incorrect audience targeting, poor ad creatives, weak offers, reliance on Meta instant forms instead of landing pages, lack of retargeting, no speed-to-lead process, and improper tracking setup. Each problem has specific symptoms, causes, and fixable solutions that roofing companies can implement immediately.
real_qa.requete: why roofing company Facebook ads fail

real_qa.q: How should roofing companies differentiate their Facebook ad offers beyond free inspections?
real_qa.r: Instead of generic offers like 'get a free quote or inspection,' use more specific offers such as 'get a free drone inspection plus a digital report within 24 hours.' You can also add urgency builders to the call to action, such as 'offer ends on September 30th,' to increase lead form conversions.
real_qa.requete: roofing free inspection ad offer alternatives

real_qa.q: Should roofing companies use Meta instant forms or landing pages for Facebook ad lead capture?
real_qa.r: Roofing companies should use designated landing pages instead of Meta instant forms because instant forms allow users to auto-fill Facebook information without realizing they've submitted a lead. A dedicated landing page with the same call-to-action as the ad ensures qualified leads and prevents customers from getting lost on your website.
real_qa.requete: Meta instant form vs landing page roofing ads

real_qa.q: What percentage of Facebook ad budget should roofing companies allocate to retargeting?
real_qa.r: Roofing companies should use 15 to 25% of their ad budget on retargeting once they have over 1,000 people in different custom audiences. Retargeting targets warmer traffic (website visitors and previous ad engagers) which costs significantly less than cold traffic.
real_qa.requete: retargeting budget percentage roofing Facebook ads

real_qa.q: What is the ideal response time for roofing companies to call Facebook ad leads?
real_qa.r: Roofing companies should call leads within 5 to 10 minutes of form submission. If unable to reach them within this window, automated SMS systems should be set up to text leads immediately with next steps and expected call time, as calling a day or two later significantly reduces callback rates.
